title: First pregnancy appointment
what: Your first visit to a gynecologist for your pregnancy. The doctor confirms the pregnancy, asks about your health, and makes a care plan.
why: As soon as you know you are pregnant. Usually you are advised to register before 12 weeks.
duration: the visit usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; test results come in 1 to 7 days
tell_doctor: The first day of your last period
All the medicines and vitamins you take
Long-term conditions: blood pressure, thyroid, diabetes
Past pregnancies, births, miscarriages, and surgeries

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop your regular medicines on your own. Tell your doctor, and they will decide what is safe in pregnancy.

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Write down what you want to ask: diet, work, exercise, vitamins.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood is often taken the same day. Ask if you need to come fasting.

bring: Ultrasound and test results, if you already have them
steps: The doctor asks about your health and past pregnancies
Your blood pressure, height, and weight are measured
A pelvic exam is done, and swabs are taken
The doctor works out how far along you are and your due date
You get referrals for tests and an ultrasound
The doctor explains your visit schedule and what to do if warning signs appear
feel: The pelvic exam may be uncomfortable, but it does not hurt
A prick when blood is taken
after: Have your tests done as listed
The next visit is usually in 2 to 4 weeks. Your doctor will give you a date
Start the vitamins your doctor prescribed
red_flags: Severe pain in the lower belly: call emergency services
Vomiting many times a day, and you cannot keep even water down

faq.q: When is it best to register?
faq.a: Usually before 12 weeks. That leaves time for important tests and the first screening.

faq.q: Should I take anything in early pregnancy?
faq.a: Folic acid is usually prescribed. Anything else only on your doctor's advice.
Usually yes. If your job is hazardous or physically hard, talk to your doctor.

reminders.text: First pregnancy appointment tomorrow. Remember the date of your last period, and bring your medicine list.
